text: summarization dont have a definition as entity?

It does: [Summarization](Harness/Automation/summarization) exists, and it summarizes `automations/summarization/agents/momentum-summarization.md`.

What it's missing is a trigger. There's no `automations/summarization/trigger.md` and no Harness/Trigger entity for it, so it has nothing like the [Preparation trigger](Harness/Trigger/preparation). That's on purpose: summarization runs as a sub-agent that a harness Stop hook starts at the end of every run, not as an automation that triggers itself. Graph build and search don't have triggers either.

If you meant something else, such as a trigger of its own or references to the automations that hand off to it, tell me and I'll add it.

I fixed the chat record's two references so the consistency guard can accept them. They're now `to:` / `relation: concerns` entries pointing at [Summarization](Harness/Automation/summarization) and the [Preparation trigger](Harness/Trigger/preparation).
